retrievalProfile.description: A multi-paneled scrapbook aesthetic featuring weathered photographic textures, handwritten notes, and a central sunset focal point.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex grid-based collage resembling a physical scrapbook, combining high-contrast sunset photography, candid lifestyle shots, and nautical symbols with prominent, expressive hand-lettered titles and vertical margin notes.
coreVisualRelationships: Central large landscape photo anchored by smaller peripheral lifestyle vignettes
Hand-lettered text overlapping the seams of the collage panels
Weathered paper textures and tape-like borders separating distinct image zones
Warm sunset lighting in the center contrasting with cooler blue-toned peripheral shots
coreInvariants: Visible paper edges and distressed borders between all image panels
A mix of horizontal and vertical text orientations

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large central landscape photo of a person facing a sunset occupies the middle third; smaller square and rectangular photos frame the top, bottom, and sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central sunset and the large-scale hand-lettered artist name directly above it.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the central sunset, moves upward to the main title, then spirals outward to the handwritten notes in the margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the layout is densely packed with images and text, using paper textures as the only 'empty' space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm golden yellows and oranges from the central sunset.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blues and teals from the ocean and sky in peripheral photos.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant reds and greens from specific subjects like the rooster and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in focal points with a weathered, slightly faded value across the paper textures.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual, expressive handwriting with varying stroke weights.
letterConstructionRules: All-caps for main titles with irregular baseline
Slanted, cursive-influenced script for secondary notes
Visible ink-bleed and rough edges on all characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'E' often features a longer middle bar
The letter 'Y' has a deep, sweeping descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast large, bold marker-style titles with thin, scratchy pen-style marginalia.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, expressive energy of the main title.
Appropriate for the marginal notes and lyrics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a multi-panel collage of beach and island lifestyle photos with weathered paper borders, torn edges, and a central sunset landscape.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, black hand-lettered titles in the center and thin, scratchy handwritten notes in the vertical margins and bottom panels.

verificationChecks: Ensure text looks hand-drawn, not typed
Check that paper textures appear aged and tactile
Verify the central sunset is the primary light source

postGenerationChecks: Are the borders between images visibly distressed?
Does the main title overlap the image seams naturally?
Is the handwriting varied in scale and weight?
Does the central image maintain focal dominance?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Island Lifestyle Photos] into a [Layout: Distressed Scrapbook Grid] with [Element: Central Sunset Focal Point] and [Typography: Bold Hand-Lettered Overlays] using a [Color: Warm Sun-Bleached Palette].
